title: Lamp pools and bloom stay under clipping
note: Lamp pools and bloom stay below clipping: at most 2% of the eye-height frame is burned to white.
intent: Clipped white has no colour and no detail, so a blown lamp pool reads as a hole in the image. Keep the bloom threshold above the diffuse range so only real emitters bloom, tone-map (ACES or Reinhard) instead of clamping, and lower the emitter's intensity rather than its radius when the pool blows. Check it on the eye-height frame under the lamp, which is where it happens, not on the default camera.

check.note: At most 2% of the eye-height frame is clipped to white — lamp pools and bloom stay below clipping.

port: The lighting facet sets tone mapping and the bloom threshold once in the mainOwner's renderer setup, and every lamp works within it.
